title: Sample: Diagnose a Jenkins build failure
summary: Trace a failed pipeline stage and recover a repeatable build.
environment: Non-production Jenkins controller and build agent
symptoms: A pipeline stops before producing its expected build artifact.
Repeated builds fail at the same stage or on the same agent.
error_messages: Build step failed with a non-zero exit code

root_cause.details: Determine whether the failure is caused by source changes, pipeline configuration, unavailable dependencies, or an unhealthy build agent.

prerequisites: Read access to the job console output and pipeline definition.
Confirm the affected branch and build identifier with the job owner.
investigation_steps: Locate the first failing pipeline stage and capture its relevant console output.
Compare the failing revision with the most recent successful build.
Check agent availability, workspace capacity, and dependency service health.
resolution_steps: Correct the confirmed source or pipeline issue through the normal review process.
Restore an unhealthy agent or approved dependency, then rerun the affected job.
verification_steps: Confirm the pipeline completes all required stages.
Verify the expected artifact is produced and associated with the intended revision.
rollback_steps: Revert the reviewed pipeline or source change if the attempted fix introduces a regression.
Disable artifact promotion until a successful verified build is available.
prevention: Keep pipeline dependencies and agent images reproducible.
Retain build logs and notify maintainers about repeated stage failures.
